articles.summary: UNESCO Headquarters in Paris saw the commencement of the Tenth Bonjour Brand Forum on June 21. CHAGEE offered its products to global guests at the summit.
articles.title: CHAGEE Visited UNESCO Headquarters, Connecting the World Through Tea

articles.summary: On June 3, CHAGEE's newly established flagship stores were unveiled in Shanghai. New products available only in Shanghai such as Iced Tea and Teaspresso, as well as new tea spaces with the concept of "TEA BAR", made their debut.
articles.title: CHAGEE Opens New Flagship Stores in Shanghai, Which Initiates a New Tea Lifestyle

articles.summary: On the Occasion of the International Tea Day 2024 – Modern Tea Innovation Forum, CHAGEE Plans to Offer Modern Tea to 100 Countries and Regions.
articles.title: CHAGEE Plans to Offer Modern Tea to 100 Countries and Regions

articles.summary: CHAGEE announced the calories and nutrients of the first batch of six products. Simultaneously, CHAGEE introduced the "Low Calories" section through its store menu, WeChat mini program, delivery platforms, and other channels, pioneering health visualization and information transparency.
articles.title: The First "Tea Drink Product ID Card" Is Released!

articles.summary: On April 26, CHAGEE officially announced its first "Health Ambassador" Zheng Qinwen. Second only to Li Na, Zheng Qinwen, the Chinese tennis player who has competed in the Grand Slam women's final, will collaborate with CHAGEE and bring healthy drinks to customers.
articles.title: Zheng Qinwen Becomes CHAGEE's First "Health Ambassador"
